question: Which of the following pigments are responsible to determine the colours of fruits and vegetables?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anthocyanins**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anthocyanins** are pigments responsible for the red, purple, and blue colors in many fruits and vegetables.
 
• These pigments belong to a class of compounds known as flavonoids and are water-soluble.
 
• Anthocyanins are found in the cell vacuoles of plant tissues and their color can change depending on the pH level.
 
• They are not only important for the coloration but also have antioxidant properties which can be beneficial for human health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carotenoids** are another class of pigments that contribute to the yellow, orange, and red colors in plants.
 
• Examples of carotenoids include beta-carotene, lycopene, and lutein.
 
• Chlorophyll is the pigment responsible for the green color in plants and is vital for photosynthesis.
 
• Different pigments can coexist in the same plant tissue, contributing to a wide range of colors.
 
• The study of plant pigments is important for understanding plant biology and for applications in food science and nutrition.
